lightgbm_features.title: LightGBM on engineered features
lightgbm_features.description: boosted trees, bought-or-not, over category, price, length and history-overlap features

svm_features.title: Linear SVM on engineered features
svm_features.description: linear SVM, bought-or-not, over the same features as the LightGBM arm

variants.inferred: five columns from the model-inferred profile; 425 of 425 customers
variants.sampled: five columns from the generator's sampled profile; 271 of 425 customers, the rest missing

missing_value: NaN for LightGBM (native handling), the scale midpoint 3.0 for the SVM
pairing: per customer, hit = hidden item in the top 10; pairs with the sampled profile are counted on the customers who have both profiles
